name: bank_settlement_amount_difference
root_cause_statement: Bank-credited amount exceeds Razorpay's computed net settlement by an amount consistent with the bank/merchant applying a lower MDR rate (1.8%) than Razorpay's actual rate (2.0%) — a fee-assumption drift, fully explained by the delta.
evidence_notes: Razorpay settlement computation breakdown (gross, MDR, GST), bank statement credited amount, delta re-derivation under the stale MDR assumption.
